initial_screen_exploration.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE production-quality visual concept image for the existing Animal Chess browser game, continuing the attached actual product screenshot. Concept name HD PIXEL GARDEN. This is a graphics upgrade proposal, not an implemented screenshot. Desktop 1440 x 1024 composition. Preserve the cozy cream background, mint-and-ivory 8x8 board, warm wood frame, animal identities and red/ivory versus navy/charcoal teams. The six pieces are chick=pawn, horse=knight, owl=bishop, bear=rook, cat=queen, lion=king. Upgrade the current tiny sprites into masterfully hand-drawn HIGH-DETAIL pixel art comparable to 64x84 pixel logical sprites: individual feather clusters, expressive faces, crisp costume seams, distinct silhouettes, crowns, restrained three-level shading, coherent pixel grid, no blur, no realistic fur. Show the entire large board at left with two complete standard starting armies, white at bottom, no cropping. All 8x8 squares exact: back rank from left is bear horse owl cat lion owl horse bear; eight chicks in front, mirrored opposing side. Quiet narrow picnic/banquet strip above board. Flat readable small standard chess-symbol badges are preserved. Right side a restrained Learn area with headline "まなぶ", title "イタリアン・ゲーム", text "中央を取り、駒を展開しよう。", and simple previous/next controls. Below it show a single enlarged lion sprite detail with small label "キャラクター詳細" to let the viewer see the art upgrade. This is one coherent art direction, not multiple options in an image. Typography Noto Sans JP style or Meiryo, never Yu Gothic or Yu Mincho. Do not add other features, progress dashboards, fantasy scenery, loud effects or numerical option labels. Header "Animal Chess". Include small footer "グラフィック検討案". Make this look intentional, polished and appreciably more detailed than reference while retaining its identity. Render full image, no browser/device chrome. Reference image is source of the existing visual identity and animal roles, not a layout to copy pixel for pixel.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished visual concept image for an upgrade to existing Animal Chess, using attached actual product screenshot as reference for identity and animal roles. Concept name STORYBOOK ATELIER. Desktop 1440 x 1024. Reinterpret the little animal chess characters as exquisite smooth 2D storybook illustrations: clean tapered ink outlines, soft painted shadow planes, delicate controlled fur and feather detail, beautifully sewn royal jackets, expressive faces; sharp silhouette readable at small sizes. No pixel art. Same cozy cream and mint/ivory palette, wood-framed exact 8x8 board on left, red/ivory clothing for white side, navy/charcoal for black, plus white vs dark base rims to distinguish teams without color alone. Chick=pawn, horse=knight, owl=bishop, bear=rook, cat=queen, lion=king. Entire standard starting board visible, white at bottom, eight chicks in front of each back rank, back rank left to right bear horse owl cat lion owl horse bear on both sides. Preserve clear small standard chess-symbol badges. Quiet small illustrated banquet/picnic strip above board. Right column focuses only on Learn: "まなぶ", "イタリアン・ゲーム", "中央を取り、駒を展開しよう。" and previous/next controls, ample readable spacing. Under lesson show an enlarged illustration of the lion king in this same style, label "キャラクター詳細". Header "Animal Chess"; small footer "グラフィック検討案". Use Noto Sans JP or Meiryo style sans serif typography, no Yu Gothic or Yu Mincho. Design a focused screen, no feature inventory, no additional panels, no photorealism, no animated-looking clutter, no device/browser chrome. One single coherent concept, not a comparison sheet or multiple options. The graphic upgrade should feel like a meticulously illustrated children's chess book for all ages, sophisticated enough for adults.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished graphics-upgrade concept for the existing Animal Chess game, grounded in attached real screenshot. Concept name MINIATURE KINGDOM. Desktop 1440 x 1024 composition. Keep its friendly animal identities and cream, mint, honey-wood palette; reinterpret pieces as finely crafted tactile miniature figurines, with charming short proportions, satin-painted wood/resin, tiny carved feathers and fabric seams, elegant small gold crown details, physically consistent soft contact shadows. This is a 2.5D pre-rendered art concept, near top-down shallow frontal board view; board squares must stay readable and pieces never obscure the square behind. Main full board on left, exactly 8x8 mint and ivory squares within a refined rounded wood frame. Two standard armies, lower side in muted brick-red/ivory clothes with ivory bases, upper side midnight-blue/charcoal clothes with dark bases. Chick=pawn, horse=knight, owl=bishop, bear=rook, cat=queen, lion=king. Back rank both sides left to right bear horse owl cat lion owl horse bear, eight chicks in front of each. Preserve standard small chess symbol badges for readability. One unobtrusive miniature banquet strip above board. Right area very simple teaching interface: "まなぶ", title "イタリアン・ゲーム", text "中央を取り、駒を展開しよう。", small previous/next controls. Under it a single enlarged miniature lion king rendering with label "キャラクター詳細". Header "Animal Chess", understated footer "グラフィック検討案". Fonts should resemble Noto Sans JP or Meiryo, never Yu Gothic or Yu Mincho. UI remains flat and highly readable; only game assets have material detail. No heavy perspective, no depth-of-field blur, no glowing magic, no photo background, no device or browser chrome. One coherent direction per image, no option numbers. Premium miniature craftsmanship but a light accessible chess-learning game.

final_art_direction_sheets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. EDIT the attached Animal Chess concept into a clean ART DIRECTION PRESENTATION SHEET, retaining exactly the animal character identities and the high-detail hand-drawn pixel art with crisp consistent pixel grid, expressive clustered-pixel fur and feathers, ornate but legible stitched royal costumes, no blur rendering style from that reference. This is a graphics comparison deliverable, not a playable game screenshot. Landscape 1536x1024. Main header "Animal Chess" and concept title "HD PIXEL GARDEN". Restrained cream base with small mint and wood accents, beautiful generous spacing.

Composition: upper half contains SIX large full-body animal characters in a single evenly spaced row, all rendered at a comparable game-art scale and facing forward. Under each one, place ONLY the exact respective label, in order left to right: "ひよこ / ポーン", "うま / ナイト", "ふくろう / ビショップ", "くま / ルーク", "ねこ / クイーン", "ライオン / キング". Pawn is a little chick in tunic, knight is recognizably horse, bishop owl with tall cap, rook bear with square-profile guard hat, queen cat with elegant pointed crown, king lion with broad mane and a distinctive crown. Make their silhouettes immediately distinct. These six main characters wear muted red/ivory costumes.

Lower half: at left, an enlarged close-up of lion head and owl costume to showcase fine material detail. In the middle show the SAME six characters at smaller in-game size in two simple horizontal rows: one red/ivory row above and one navy/charcoal row below, with ivory vs dark base rims where the art style has bases. Small rows label only "白チーム" and "黒チーム". At right, three tasteful material swatches from this art style: pale mint board-square material, ivory board-square material, warm wood frame material. Each swatch is a standalone single square or short rectangle, NOT a chessboard. Bottom footer exact "グラフィック検討案".

IMPORTANT remove ALL complete chessboards, all game UI cards, all move diagrams, all arrows, all dots indicating moves, all chess-symbol badges, all game rules/explanations, all invented paragraphs and all numerical option labels. There must be NO chess position or teaching diagram to misrepresent chess rules. The single sheet must present one coherent graphics direction only. Do NOT paste any UI or chessboard from the reference. Do not reproduce the reference's explanatory text. Only allowed text is the requested header/title/six labels/team labels/footer. Japanese typography resembles Noto Sans JP or Meiryo, never Yu Gothic or Yu Mincho. Preserve charm, warm color balance, art consistency, and fine detail. No browser chrome, device frame, photo background, extraneous decorative scenery, or watermark.
